title: Retrospective analysis of oncological outcomes in vulvar cancer following adjuvant or definitive radiotherapy
summary: This retrospective study examines the treatment outcomes of female patients with vulvar cancer who received radiotherapy at University Hospital Düsseldorf between 1 January 1998 and 30 November 2025. Information that has already been documented in the patients’ medical records will be analyzed. The study will evaluate, among other aspects, the type and delivery of radiotherapy, additional treatments, and the course of the disease after treatment. In particular, the study will assess whether and when the cancer recurs locally or in the lymph nodes, whether distant metastases develop, and how long patients survive after treatment. Acute and long-term treatment-related side effects and complications will also be assessed. The aim of the study is to evaluate treatment outcomes under routine clinical conditions and to identify factors associated with treatment success, disease recurrence, or treatment-related side effects. As this is a retrospective study, no additional examinations or treatments will be performed.
